## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the new `CRITERION_HINT` wording, because it tells users to drop "shall" while the `require_shall` validator option still rejects criteria that lack it.

## Changes
The pull request rewords `CRITERION_HINT` so it tells users to write direct action bullets without "shall", and it adds the literal `- ` prefix to `BULLET_HINT`. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file at the repository root.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Make the hint conditional on require_shall — When `require_shall=True`, a criterion written as the hint says, such as `- Save the result`, is rejected because `accepts_criterion` returns `" shall " in text` (`app/criteria.py:7-8`). `tests/test_criteria.py:20-21` asserts that this rejection is intended. — Users of deployments that set `require_shall: true` get a hint that leads every criterion they write to fail validation. — Fix: Keep a "shall" variant of the hint and select it whenever `require_shall` is enabled, or make the hint neutral about the word "shall".
